note: Layers are square transparent PNGs on one shared canvas (authored at 2000x2000, shipped at 1000x1000), so they stack with no offsets. Draw in list order, first = bottom. An accessory layer must be a square transparent PNG drawn on the same canvas; it is inserted at a slot: 'after' = directly above the named layer, 'before' = directly below it. Do not trim layers.

clothing_torso.note: shirts, scarves, bow ties; stays under eyes, violin and arms

face.note: glasses, masks; above the eyes, brows, teeth and mustache

clothing_lower.note: skirts and dresses; over the legs and boots, under the instrument and arms

monocle.note: monocle lens: above the eyes, under the teeth and mustache (the chain uses the face slot, over the mustache)

pants.note: pants: over legs and shoes, under instruments
